basics.type: Private state university, set up under the Lovely Professional University Act, 2005 (Punjab Act 25 of 2005)
basics.ugc: Recognised under Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.other: Approved by NCTE, PCI, COA and BCI; B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture accredited by ICAR

placements.source: NIRF 2025 management data submitted by LPU

admission: 60% aggregate in Class 12 with Physics, Mathematics and English (Chemistry or Biology for some branches)
LPUNEST; a few CSE programmes also need an interview
LPUNEST, CAT, XAT, MAT or CMAT
LPUNEST is the eligibility and scholarship test for most programmes; national tests such as JEE Main, NEET, UCEED, CAT and MAT count for some

scholarships.text: Scholarships are based on LPUNEST scores, in categories set by cut-off marks (for B.Tech, tentative cut-offs are 300, 212 and 150 out of 400). LPU also has sports and talent scholarships through trials and auditions.

hostel.text: On-campus residential facilities; students apply for hostel, mess and transport while taking admission.

fees.text: LPU publishes programme-wise fees with LPUNEST scholarship amounts on each programme's fee and scholarship page.
